title: Search Basics
description: Find anything instantly with powerful search and filters

steps.title: Open Search
steps.description: Press Ctrl+F or click the search icon in the toolbar

steps.title: Basic Search
steps.description: Type keywords to search note content, titles, and tags

steps.title: Search Operators
steps.description: Use tag:#tag, property:key=value, date:>2026-01-01, author:pubkey for precise queries

steps.title: Save Searches
steps.description: Click the star icon next to a search to save it as a quick filter in the sidebar

steps.title: Search History
steps.description: Recent searches appear below the input for quick re-use
